questionText:
Write a piece of continuous prose in Russian (140
words) in answer to ONE of the following. In your
answer make sure to include ALL the points listed.

You may use vocabulary and turns of phrase from
texts in other sections of the examination paper, but
marks will not be awarded for segments of your essay
which  replicate word  for word segments from
examination texts.

1. LETTER
a) Write a letter that Seryozhka wrote to his
  grandmother about adopting a pet from a local
   animal shelter. In your letter, you should refer to
   the following:
      description of the pet, its personality or
        habits;
     Seryozhka’s responsibilities;
     an amusing episode involving the new pet.

OR

b) Write a letter of enquiry about voluntary
   opportunities at the zoo. In your letter, you
   should refer to the following:
     your personal details;
     your interests and motivation;
     relevant skills or experience.

2. NARRATIVE
a) Write an account of a time someone unexpectedly
   helped you.

OR

b) Maria and her friends (Comprehension Text,
   Section II) went on a trip to Europe after their
   graduation from school. Write Maria’s blog entry
  about their experience. You should address the
   following:
      overall impression from the trip;
     challenges faced and how they were
      overcome;
     Maria’s advice to her followers about
        travelling.

3. DISCUSSION
a) Discuss the importance of balancing studies and
   leisure.

OR
b) Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of
studying at your home town vs. moving away to go
to college.
